articles.title: YouTube is reportedly preparing to settle social media addiction claims for $3 billion
articles.essence: YouTube is preparing to pay $3 billion to thousands of school districts to settle claims that its "addictive design" harmed kids, according to Bloomberg. Sources tell the publication that YouTube reached the agreement "in principle," and that the deal would also include new safeguards for teens.

articles.title: Rockstar says GTA VI made $3.79 billion in its first day
articles.essence: GTA VI earned $3.79 billion in its first day of sales, which set "a new record for entertainment across any medium," according to an announcement from Rockstar Games. The game also sold 32.5 million preorder copies.
